name: Ford Focus RS
h1: Ford Focus RS: performance, engines and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA files almost every Focus RS complaint under Focus (only six 2016 complaints are filed as Focus RS, and the Focus search includes them), so these counts are every Focus of these years.

gens.tag: 350-hp EcoBoost, manual only, torque-vectoring all-wheel drive.

weight.note: Wikipedia figure, no maker source found

variants.name: Focus RS Limited Edition

tq.note: lb-ft; Wikipedia says output was unchanged

variants.what: Adds a Quaife mechanical front limited-slip differential, forged 19-inch wheels, black roof and the RS2 interior. 1,000 for the U.S.

EB23RS.name: Ford 2.3 EcoBoost (Focus RS)
facts: Twin-scroll turbo with a larger compressor, much bigger intercooler
Aluminum block with stronger cast-iron liners; heat-resistant alloy head

issues.x: On 2016–2017 cars built through July 6, 2017, the head gasket can leak coolant into the cylinders, showing as white smoke or a dropping coolant level with no outside leak.
issues.fix: Ford program 17B32 pressure-tested and replaced the gasket (or the head) free, with no mileage limit, through May 31, 2019.

issues.x: Ford says track use and long stints at high rpm can raise oil use on early cars, and running low on oil can destroy the engine.
issues.fix: Program 16B43 reprogrammed the engine computer to call for oil changes sooner; Ford tells owners to check the oil more often.

issues.t: Oil seep at the head joint
issues.x: Some 2016–2018 engines seep oil where the cylinder head meets the block.
issues.fix: Dealers reseal it using a revised sealant procedure (Ford SSM 47443).

issues.x: On 438 Focus RS cars with a factory block heater, the heater can leak coolant and short out when plugged in, a fire risk.
issues.fix: Don't plug it in; dealers replace the heater or fit a blanking plug free (Ford 25SA4, NHTSA 26V-012).
